name: dataclean-mcp
description: Cleans CSV, Excel and JSON tables deterministically: European/US numbers, day/month dates, NUL bytes, mojibake, phones, emails, dedupe and schema validation.
long_description: Data hygiene for AI agents. Profiles a table (types, number locale, date order, nulls, duplicates, problems), returns a clean typed copy as CSV, JSON or .xlsx, validates rows against a schema and normalizes lists of values. Ambiguous values are flagged, never guessed. Pay per call with KeyFlint credits.

tools.name: profile_table
tools.description: Profile a table: real column types, number locale, date order, nulls, duplicates and problems, plus a suggested schema.

tools.name: clean_table
tools.description: Return a clean, typed copy of a table (CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL or .xlsx) with a report of every change.

tools.name: validate_schema
tools.description: Check every row against a schema: types, required, unique, min/max, enum, pattern.

tools.name: normalize_values
tools.description: Normalize a list of numbers, dates, phones, emails, IBANs or booleans.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Credit price of each tool and where to buy credits. Free.

tools.description: Remaining credits on your KeyFlint license. Free.
